{{Top|leg}}
The '''"Short Round" barrel''' was a type of [[laser barrel]] manufactured by [[Magna-Lok]]. Lightweight and easily serviced, they were standard issue on [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], including the [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]].
